title: Papyrus deployments created through an API and held as data (shared tier)
description: Ryan's decision (2026-11-08, relayed by the Papyrus implementation session): launching a new site must need only data changes, never a code edit or deploy. Target: one papyrus product with tenant deployments created through an API and stored as Prospectus data, replacing a reviewed accounts/papyrus-sites.json entry per site for the shared tier. The shared tier signs in through ONE shared Google OAuth client by default; tenancy comes from the deployment record and Account membership, so there is no per-site Cognito pool, client or role registration. Later a tenant may bring its own Google client ID and secret. Correction (Ryan, 2026-11-09): the design partner's three new sites launch DIRECTLY on the shared tier at Papyrus milestone M7 and are never dedicated sites, so the deployment record and API, shared sign-in, shared-tier cost accounting and the joint security review must all be ready for the partner at M7 (Papyrus PR #1305, PPY-37f2ec). Existing dedicated sites stay on the per-site registry. Needs its own security review before any build reaches production. Related: kanbus-59284c (provisioning API), kanbus-4c99c6 (operator account setup), kanbus-db57cb (Papyrus as one sellable family), kanbus-6efecd (lifecycle events), kanbus-b19d5a (billing standing), kanbus-bb0b6c (cost accounting).
